newsitem.title: DUBAI: Forte says to manage new Dubai hotel.
newsitem.headline: Forte says to manage new Dubai hotel.

text.p: Granada Group Plc's Forte Hotels said on Monday it signed a management contract for a new seaside hotel being built in Dubai in the United Arab Emirates.
In a statement, Forte said it would manage the five-star Le Meridien Mina Seyahi Resort which is due to be completed in the fourth quarter of 1998.

The 204-room, 10-storey hotel will be the third hotel in Dubai to be managed by Forte. The hotel company also said it would soon brand the two existing Dubai properties as Le Meridien and no longer Forte Grand hotels.
